cards.info: What does the symbol $\hat{y}$ (y-hat) represent in a regression equation?
cards.backInfo: It represents the predicted value of the dependent variable based on the model.

cards.info: How do you calculate a predicted value using a regression equation?
cards.backInfo: Substitute the given $x$-value into the equation and solve for $\hat{y}$.

cards.info: What is the formula for calculating a residual?
cards.backInfo: Residual = Actual $y$ - Predicted $\hat{y}$.

cards.info: What does a positive residual indicate about the actual observed value?
cards.backInfo: It indicates the actual observed value is greater than the predicted value.

cards.info: What does a negative residual indicate about the actual observed value?
cards.backInfo: It indicates the actual observed value is less than the predicted value.

cards.info: Where is a data point located if it has a positive residual?
cards.backInfo: The data point is located above the regression line on a scatterplot.
cards.imageMarkdown: ![A scatter plot showing a regression line with one point above the line (positive residual) and one point below the line (negative residual).](https://img.justsolvely.com/followUpImage/615edd53-0516-4076-8804-c277e6dd8dfb-1786506193911-26.webp)

cards.info: What error occurs if you calculate Predicted minus Actual for a residual?
cards.backInfo: This common error flips the sign (positive/negative) of the resulting residual.

cards.info: What distance does a residual measure on a scatterplot?
cards.backInfo: It measures the vertical distance between an observed data point and the regression line.

cards.info: What is the residual if the actual value equals the predicted value?
cards.backInfo: The residual is exactly zero, meaning the point lies on the regression line.

cards.info: What is the sign of the residual if a model overestimates a value?
cards.backInfo: The residual will be negative because the actual value is lower than predicted.

cards.info: In the regression model $\hat{y} = a + bx$, which variable is the prediction?
cards.backInfo: The variable $\hat{y}$ (y-hat) is the predicted value of the dependent variable.

cards.info: Given $\hat{y} = 10 + 5x$, what is the first step to find the residual?
cards.backInfo: Substitute the given $x$ into the equation to calculate the predicted value $\hat{y}$.

cards.info: To avoid sign errors, what mnemonic helps remember the residual formula order?
cards.backInfo: Use 'A - P' which stands for Actual $y$ minus Predicted $\hat{y}$.

cards.info: If the model underestimates a value, is the residual positive or negative?
cards.backInfo: The residual is positive because the actual value is higher than the prediction.

cards.info: If Actual $y = 30$ and Predicted $\hat{y} = 32$, what is the residual?
cards.backInfo: The residual is $-2$, indicating the actual value is less than predicted.

cards.info: A point is above the regression line. What does this imply about $y$?
cards.backInfo: The actual $y$ is greater than the predicted $\hat{y}$, resulting in a positive residual.
cards.imageMarkdown: ![A scatter plot showing a regression line with one point above the line (positive residual) and one point below the line (negative residual).](https://img.justsolvely.com/followUpImage/615edd53-0516-4076-8804-c277e6dd8dfb-1786506193911-26.webp)

cards.info: Where is a data point located if it has a negative residual?
cards.backInfo: The data point is located below the regression line on a scatterplot.
cards.imageMarkdown: ![A scatter plot showing a regression line with one point above the line (positive residual) and one point below the line (negative residual).](https://img.justsolvely.com/followUpImage/615edd53-0516-4076-8804-c277e6dd8dfb-1786506193911-26.webp)

cards.info: Why is the order of subtraction critical when calculating a residual?
cards.backInfo: Reversing the order (Predicted - Actual) incorrectly flips the sign of the error.

cards.info: Does a residual measure horizontal or vertical distance on a scatterplot?
cards.backInfo: It measures the vertical distance between the observed point and the regression line.

cards.info: If a data point lies exactly on the regression line, what is its residual?
cards.backInfo: The residual is zero because the actual value equals the predicted value.
